input.quote: This Agreement is the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, superseding any prior agreements and communications (both written and oral) regarding such subject matter.
input.rationale: We reviewed the entire Agreement for personnel restrictive covenants: Section 5.4 (General Managers/liaisons, p0034-p0035), the surrounding Sections 6 (Exclusivity), 7 (Cross-Promotions), 8 (Confidentiality), 9 (Warranties) and 10 (General Provisions), and Sections 1-5. Targeted searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce", "recruit" and "personnel" return only incidental references (HDI's "employees, or agents" in the confidentiality carve-out at p0051 and the independent-contractor/"agent, partner, employee or representative" language at p0061), neither of which restricts either Party from soliciting, employing or hiring the other's staff. The only restrictive covenants are the Section 6 exclusivity/field covenants (p0037, p0042), which concern competing web projects and the "Deerskin" brand, not personnel. With the integration clause confirming no other terms apply, the Company is subject to no non-solicitation or no-hire obligation, which meets the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer); no redline is required. Note for the file: because the Agreement is silent, we likewise have no non-solicit protection against HDI, but the playbook does not require us to introduce one.
